About these 18 rides

There’s a ride every day of the week; Thursday has the most, with 5. The earliest start is Saturday Tualatin Ride at 9:00 am; the latest is NoPo Night Ride at 8:05 pm. After work, 10 roll on a weekday evening. The group waits for everyone on 5 of them (no-drop), and beginners are welcome on 1. There are 2 rides made for LGBTQ+ riders, 1 for women, trans and femme riders and 1 for families. Each one was checked at its source between Oct 1 and Oct 26, 2026.
